answer: Peers sample attestations like seeds scattered across a grove, and identities that fail to root in that grove get pruned. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond tied to a unique verified relic of prior work, so creating N fake identities costs N bonds. On the cold tundra of fresh accounts, bonds must survive a 30-day challenge window before voting power activates, making mass fabrication prohibitively expensive.
